title: Bus with a smiling face
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Body -->
  <rect x='10' y='25' width='80' height='45' rx='10' fill='#f5c518'/>
  <!-- Roof stripe -->
  <rect x='14' y='28' width='72' height='6' rx='3' fill='#ffdd55'/>
  <!-- Windows -->
  <rect x='18' y='38' width='18' height='16' rx='4' fill='#4fc3f7'/>
  <rect x='41' y='38' width='18' height='16' rx='4' fill='#4fc3f7'/>
  <rect x='64' y='38' width='18' height='16' rx='4' fill='#4fc3f7'/>
  <!-- Window shine -->
  <rect x='21' y='41' width='5' height='6' rx='2' fill='#b3e5fc'/>
  <rect x='44' y='41' width='5' height='6' rx='2' fill='#b3e5fc'/>
  <rect x='67' y='41' width='5' height='6' rx='2' fill='#b3e5fc'/>
  <!-- Smile -->
  <path d='M30 60 Q50 72 70 60' stroke='#e65100' stroke-width='3.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- Eyes -->
  <circle cx='35' cy='55' r='3.5' fill='#e65100'/>
  <circle cx='65' cy='55' r='3.5' fill='#e65100'/>
  <!-- Cheeks -->
  <circle cx='28' cy='62' r='4' fill='#ff8a65' opacity='0.7'/>
  <circle cx='72' cy='62' r='4' fill='#ff8a65' opacity='0.7'/>
  <!-- Bumper -->
  <rect x='12' y='68' width='76' height='6' rx='3' fill='#b0bec5'/>
  <!-- Wheels -->
  <circle cx='28' cy='75' r='8' fill='#37474f'/>
  <circle cx='28' cy='75' r='4' fill='#90a4ae'/>
  <circle cx='72' cy='75' r='8' fill='#37474f'/>
  <circle cx='72' cy='75' r='4' fill='#90a4ae'/>
  <!-- Headlights -->
  <circle cx='16' cy='52' r='3' fill='#fff9c4'/>
  <circle cx='84' cy='52' r='3' fill='#fff9c4'/>
  <!-- Door -->
  <rect x='44' y='42' width='12' height='24' rx='3' fill='#e6a700'/>
  <rect x='45' y='38' width='10' height='2' rx='1' fill='#e6a700'/>
</svg>
